context: After school by the bike racks. Riku just finished the latest chapter of a manga they both read; Sakura is dying for spoilers but pretending not to be.
purpose: teen banter / shared fandom — friendship through teasing and enthusiasm

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ねえ、今週のやつ、もう読んだ？
lines.en: Hey, this week's one — you read it yet?
lines.style: Teen boy casual cadence, breezy with a small teasing lift on the question mark, almost daring her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: まだ！言わないでよ、絶対！
lines.en: Not yet! Don't tell me, I mean it!
lines.style: Sharp teen girl protest spiking on 「絶対」, mock-panic with real urgency underneath the playful surface.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いやでも今回はマジでやばいって。
lines.en: Yeah but this time it's seriously crazy though.
lines.style: Pulling-back teen drawl, lazy but loaded, 「マジで」 dropped low like he's already half-spoiling.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 言わないで！本当に言わないで！
lines.en: Don't tell me! I mean really don't tell me!
lines.style: Hands-over-ears teen volume bump on the repeats, somewhere between laughing and serious about it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: わかったわかった。じゃあ、感想だけ後で聞かせて。
lines.en: Okay okay. Then just tell me your reaction afterwards.
lines.style: Backing-down teen grin in the voice, casual shrug delivered through tone alone, ending mild and friendly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今夜読む！面白いってこと？
lines.en: I'll read it tonight! So it's good then?
lines.style: Quick teen pivot from defense to curiosity, lift on the question, already excited about reading later.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 面白いどころじゃない。次の話が気になりすぎる。
lines.en: More than just good. I want the next chapter way too much.
lines.style: Earnest teen emphasis, voice raised slightly with genuine investment, drops back on 「気になりすぎる」 sincerely.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: じゃあ明日感想言うから、待ってて。
lines.en: Then I'll tell you my reaction tomorrow, just wait.
lines.style: Resolved teen lift, almost a promise, ending warm and looking forward to comparing notes together.
